notes.title: Android release and more balance updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/c80e60fe1f998cf6715d8d702e20df6ea13bc600.png[/img]

[h1]Android Release[/h1]
You can now play Chess Cubed anywhere!  Cross-platform play has come to the Android platform. [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DefaultSoftware.ChessCubed] Download Chess Cubed[/url]  from the Play Store.

[h1]New mode[/h1]
Survival mode has been added. When this mode is selected HP will not regenerate. 

[h1]Balance updates[/h1]
♞ Knight movement cost has been updated to reflect a better cost to mobility balance. This balance update supports the movement sequence pictured below at a cost of 2 energy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/06ada93371502b4586eaa9b737e1b69356baa47b.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/00e1af36239173125e19c5107aa571d6e4632ae2.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/b4b4d22b293e42bc18f4ce9917b7b83e0c347d5f.png[/img]

Just imagine the possibilities...

notes.title: Updates!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/7fd057f6b04b7282f0377c55adf84c6b725d8a21.png[/img]

Music is now customizable in settings. You can choose the song that play for When you are Tied, Winning or Losing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/b34af965e7f1798bf7915b0612036e3719ca7aca.png[/img]

[h1] Contextual Highlights [/h1]
[i]Pieces now have colored Highlights for various states of game play[/i]

[b]Green[/b] - This piece has an available move.
[b]Yellow[/b] - This piece is encroaching on your king.
[b]Red[/b] - This piece is checking your king.
[b]Blue[/b] - This piece (yours) is attacking the enemy king.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/4ad51d4851c7c230b24a887c10569625a7cc4b53.png[/img]

Finally, Night mode is now an option in the lower drawer menu. The other drawers are less 'twitchy' and the minimap stays until you close it.

Next up:
Trial Mode.(puzzles and etc)
Achievements.

Oh, and Android users will be joining you by this Friday.... yup.
See you around!

- AFG

notes.title: Night Mode and Region Changes
notes.content:

notes.title: Suggest New Formations!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/c1e3c7cac70a58ebd1f4318693fc19d3b9ce2bec.png[/img]

In tradition Chess the 3rd row is empty but in Chess Cubed the is a formation option that allows some extra pawns to be placed there. 
Question:

What other arrangements would you like?
Are you against formations where pieces are spawned below the Cube?
Are you open to formations that introduce extra Rooks, Knights, and Bishops?

This is all optional of course but we'd like to get your feedback. Thanks in advance!

notes.content: In 30 min. Feel free to tell your friends on Reddit, Facebook, Twitter, etc.  Thanks for the support people! Be sure to give us hell so we can make a better product!

notes.title: Should we launch NOW, without the AI and etc?
notes.content:
[b]Edit:[/b] [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfZLvA1wLA_yEC8_b6q9fnU3SegVKHxnzUttd0kc3fMxRZycA/viewform?usp=sf_link] Poll Here [/url] 

We've had quite a few people ask about the status of the game so I thought I'd clear some things up:

1 - We planned on launching when the AI was finished(close but not done).

2 - Integrate a mode where people could play each-other for money. 

3 - Change up some of the games inner-workings and matchmaking menus.


The game is quite playable and already has local and online mode with replays.

The Question is:

Would you all be willing to play the game in its current state? 

It would be about a month early but I guess this is what Early Access is for right? I don't know how to do a poll but if someone made a poll, or enough people respond to this announcement, then I will launch the game next week. 
That sound good?

notes.title: 2 Solver Behaviours Added?! New UI 90% done.
notes.content:
First - what is a Solver Behaviour? 
  Think of it as a silent observer that watches your game with an intent to modify the cube to a Pattern it desires. In between turns, The solver will rotate the cube so long as neither player are in check/mate.This is optional. Don't freak out! 

Here are the 2 we have so far:

Normal
 this solver is self explanatory. The solver will rotate the cube  on the shortest path to a completely solved cube.

Undo
Similar to Normal except this Solver solves the cube by Undoing all moves made by players! A subtle but important difference.

Checkered and Stripe patterns are next but first we'll see how these do for now! Once again, these are optional. Don't freak out! 

As for the UI:

Before:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32250949/8f9c9ef5fb63240af9506ea669a9bfe0fbc97bb0.png[/img]

Again, sorry for the delay, hope to see you all soon!

P.S. Beta testers... good luck.

notes.title: Slight Delay on Release.
notes.content:
We are delaying the release by a couple of days to attempt to get the AI in working order. As you might imagine, given the games complexity, it's not a walk in the park! Thank you for your patience. Right now these are the features we have for Early Access:

Online Multiplayer is done.
Local Multiplayer is Done.
Replays Done.
Mid Match Resume / Game Saving is Done.
Game modes Done. We are working on Some extra modes though.
Tool tips and basic settings Done.
